# mtncloud_jobs (Data Source)

Lists your jobs, including those made in the console. Jobs run a task or workflow on a schedule or on demand.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_jobs" "all" {}

output "jobs" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_jobs.all.jobs : x.id => { name = x.name, last_result = x.last_result } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Only list jobs whose `enabled` is this.
- `labels` (List of String) Only list jobs that have every one of these `labels` (case ignored).
- `name_regex` (String) Only return jobs whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `target_type` (String) Only list jobs whose `target_type` is this (case ignored).
- `type` (String) Only list jobs whose `type` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `jobs` (Attributes List) The jobs, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the job is enabled.
- `id` (Number) ID of the job.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
- `last_result` (String) Result of the last run, or empty.
- `last_run` (String) Last run (RFC 3339), or empty.
- `name` (String) Name of the job.
- `target_type` (String) What it runs on, for example `instance`.
- `type` (String) Job type.
